item.title: 298217 : I-64 West between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60 in Franklin County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight alternating lane closures on Interstate 64 West beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, in Franklin County. Overnight alternating lane closures will occur nightly from 7 p.m. through 6 a.m. beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, through Friday, Aug. 14, on I-64 West between mile markers 53 and 58 (between U.S. 127 and U.S. 60). The overnight alternating lane closures are necessary for contract crews to perform asphalt paving operations. Motorists are advised to follow all lane closure restrictions, use caution when traveling through the work zone, and plan for additional travel time. The work is part of the I-64 improvement project [links-1.govdelivery.com] between the Frankfort exits (mile markers 53 and 58), which includes milling removing the existing asphalt surface followed by resurfacing with new asphalt pavement. Other improvements to the 5-mile corridor include bridge repairs and bridge crash wall repairs. Construction is scheduled to be completed by the Fall of 2026. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. For the latest traffic and travel updates across the Commonwealth of Kentucky, visit goky.ky.gov [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Information specific to District 5 counties is also available on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com].

item.title: 269220 : I-71 North-South between MM 0.1 and 2.0 Between I-64/I-71 Interchange and Zorn Ave. in Jefferson County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : The I-71 widening and improvement project is a $50 million infrastructure investment to enhance safety and improve mobility along one of Louisville's most critical travel corridors. The two-year project, focused on increasing traffic capacity and safety, will enhance regional connectivity, provide reliable travel for years to come, and support economic growth. The project spans approximately two miles of interstate from the I-65/I-71 interchange near Frankfort Avenue to the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange. Additional improvements include the construction of a multi-use path along Zorn Avenue between the I-71/Zorn Avenue interchange and Mellwood Avenue, as well as a new median treatment at the intersection of Zorn Avenue and Mellwood Avenue to enhance safety and better define traffic movements. The project also includes the demolition and reconstruction of the I-71 bridge over Beargrass Creek, along with a latex overlay on the I-71 bridge over I-64 at mile point 0.3 to extend the structure’s service life. For additional information, please visist https://transportation.ky.gov/DistrictFive/Pages/I-71-Widening---Louisville-.aspx.

item.title: 300566 : I-71 North-South between MM 53.0 and 58.0 Between Sparta Pike and KY-1039 in Gallatin County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : I-71 – 52.77 – 57.36 mile points – A widening project aimed at reducing congestion and improving safety on I-71 in Carroll and Gallatin counties is in progress. The project will widen I-71 from its configuration of two lanes in each direction, to three lanes. Ramp closures on I-71 northbound in Gallatin County are scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. on Sunday, Aug. 9. Crews will perform ramp work, including milling and paving operations, ramp widening and shoulder work. Due to the scope of work, these ramps will be closed continuously for an extended period during this phase of the project. A signed detour will be in place utilizing Boone Road (KY 465). The following ramps will be closed: -Exit 55 (KY 1039) on-ramp to I-71 southbound -I-71 northbound off-ramp to Exit 57 (Sparta Pike) Weather permitting, these ramp closures are expected to be in place through Sunday, Aug. 23. Additional updates will be provided if more time is needed to complete the work. .

item.title: 254857 : I-264 East-West between MM 21.5 and 22.9 Area of US-42 in Jefferson County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : UPDATE (March 23, 2026) – The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) advises motorists of overnight lane and ramp closures on Interstate 264 East and West (Watterson Expressway) beginning Tuesday, March 24, as part of the $130 million widening and improvement project of I-264 and U.S. 42 (Brownsboro Road) [links-1.govdelivery.com]. Beginning Tuesday, March 24, at 8 p.m., through Wednesday, March 25, at 6 a.m.: Alternating lane closures will occur on I-264 East and West between mile markers 23 and 22 (from the I-264/I-71 split to U.S. 42/Brownsboro Road). Beginning Wednesday, March 25, at 8 p.m., through Thursday, March 26, at 6 a.m.: The I-264 East ramp to I-71 South will be closed. Motorists should continue on I-264 East, take I-71 North, then follow I-265 North to reconnect with I-71 South. Alternating lane closures will occur on I-264 East between mile markers 23 and 22 (from the I-264/I-71 split to U.S. 42/Brownsboro Road). Motorists should heed signage, use caution when traveling through the work zone, and plan ahead for travel delays. The highway improvement project is expected to be completed by the Fall of 2027. More details, including project timelines and traffic impacts [links-1.govdelivery.com], will be shared online as work progresses. Motorists are encouraged to sign up for email or text alerts [links-1.govdelivery.com] regarding weekly traffic impacts pertaining to the project.

item.title: 299704 : I-65 South between MM 137.0 and 136.5 On Kennedy Bridge in Jefferson County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : UPDATE 8/15/2026 Beginning Saturday, Aug. 15, at 12 p.m., through Sunday, Aug. 16, at 6 p.m. The right three lanes of the Kennedy Bridge will be closed. The I-65 South to I-64 West ramp remains closed and will reopen on Sunday, Aug. 16, at 6 p.m. As work on the final phase of the expansion joint replacement project on the John F. Kennedy Memorial Bridge nears completion, contract crews will implement lane and ramp closures beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, to safely restore the bridge to its permanent traffic configuration. The project will preserve and extend the service life of this critical Ohio River crossing. Beginning Sunday, Aug. 2, at 8 p.m., through 6 a.m. on Monday, Aug. 17, at 6 a.m.: The Court Avenue and 6th Street on-ramps to I-65 South in Jeffersonville, Indiana, will be closed. The right two lanes of the Kennedy Bridge and the I-65 South to I-64 West ramp will be closed. Beginning Friday, Aug. 7, at 8 p.m., through Monday, Aug. 10, at 6 a.m. (If inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances arise, contract crews will perform the below traffic control measures beginning Friday, Aug. 14, at 8 p.m., through Monday, Aug. 17, at 6 a.m.): The right three lanes of the Kennedy Bridge will be closed. Motorists should heed signage, use caution, and plan for additional travel time. Kennedy Bridge Expansion Joint Project Work on replacing bridge expansion joints began in February 2025 as a more permanent solution for damaged joints and to replace all joints, promoting safer and smoother traffic flow. Expansion joints are critical components of a bridge deck that allow the structure to safely expand and contract with temperature changes. This flexibility helps prevent cracking and preserves the bridge’s long-term structural integrity. The date and duration of this work may be adjusted if inclement weather or other unforeseen delays occur. item.title: 292980 : I-71/75 North Ramp to 12th Street/MLK Jr. Boulevard in Kenton County
item.description: Construction / Road Work : (June 5, 2026) – Interstate 71/75 ramp closures and detours in Covington are needed to safely advance construction on the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor Project, which will add interstate lanes, better access, a new companion bridge and convert the existing bridge for local travel to improve safety and increase regional highway capacity. Temporary closures and detours will now begin on Monday, June 8, and will take place in multiple phases. On Monday, June 8, the following closures are expected to take place: I-71/75 northbound off-ramp to 12th Street/MLK Jr. Blvd. (0.0 - 0.28 mile points): this closure will remain in place through Summer 2027. Detour: Traffic will use the I-71/75 northbound 5th Street exit ramp, turn left (north) onto Philadelphia Street, then left onto 4th Street driving west to the I-71/75 southbound ramp to Pike Street. Turn left on to Pike Street, then right on to Simon Kenton Way, then left on to MLK Blvd. KYTC will provide further updates ahead of the closures to inform all road users via the Brent Spence Bridge Corridor project website. [links-1.govdelivery.com] Project schedules are subject to change due to inclement weather or other unforeseen circumstances. For the most current information on road construction in Northern Kentucky, please visit the District 6 Roadshow [links-1.govdelivery.com] or the Driving Northern Kentucky Progress [links-1.govdelivery.com] website. You can also stay informed by following KYTC District 6 on Facebook [links-1.govdelivery.com] and X [links-1.govdelivery.com] (formerly Twitter). For statewide traffic and travel updates, visit GoKY [links-1.govdelivery.com].
